entries.title: Why my brother decided to move to Austria.
entries.body:
My brother is currently as a waiter at Goldene Kugel in Salzburg, Austria. But why ? The reason is because of me as his younger brother. See, I am currently as student/pupil (specifically) in the same city. But, I would be alone and kind of boring. So, I tried finding job for my brother with the help of my guardian in Austria. Fortunately, after 4-5 months of finding, he received his job as a waiter, after which he received his A.M.S, Security Guarantee and Work Contract. These documents are sent in India via my guardian. 

See, in order to reduce the rejection of your Visa/Residence Permit and to increase the speed of your visa application, it would be good to have a guardian from Germany/Austria. This case applied to me as I have a guardian. Also, very important to note that guardian should not be only for visa application as it will be rejected, but rather a guardian who is related to your family members of bloodline. You have to type a letter stating how your guardian is related to your family. If your guardian has years of friendship with your family, it is better.
